title: #360 Learning Past
prompt: Learning about the past has no value for those of us living in the present. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: Learning about the past has no value for those of us living in the present.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning about the past helps people understand how life has changed over time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning about the past helps people understand how life has changed over time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Learning about the past helps us understand our culture and identity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning about the past helps us understand our culture and identity.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that learning about the past is beneficial because it provides knowledge about human life and builds a sense of identity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that learning about the past is beneficial because it provides knowledge about human life and builds a sense of identity.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay uses simple, clear language and short sentences, maintaining a consistent A2-B1 level throughout the text.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay uses simple, clear language and short sentences, maintaining a consistent A2-B1 level throughout the text.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first main point is that studying history provides valuable knowledge about how societies develop over time. This is supported by the example of the Industrial Revolution.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first main point is that studying history provides valuable knowledge about how societies develop over time. This is supported by the example of the Industrial Revolution.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second main point is that learning about the past helps us avoid making the same mistakes again. This is supported by the example of studying past conflicts.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second main point is that learning about the past helps us avoid making the same mistakes again. This is supported by the example of studying past conflicts.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that historical knowledge helps people understand current social problems and make better decisions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that historical knowledge helps people understand current social problems and make better decisions.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that studying history helps people appreciate progress and understand human development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that studying history helps people appreciate progress and understand human development.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
